FX-PARA-001.says: The settings as they start: #6450a0 from below (direction 180), spread 70, opacity 50, multiply. The block's bottom row, row 8, is darkened toward violet the most, each row above less, and rows 1 and 2, more than 70 per cent of the figure's eight rows up, not at all; the dot at (14, 4) is darkened as row 4 is; the empty pixels stay empty.

FX-PARA-002.says: From below, spread 100, opacity 100, normal: row 8 wholly violet at each pixel's own covering, and each row above less violet on the smooth curve, row 1 by 1 - s s (3 - 2 s) at s = 7/8, about 0.043.

FX-PARA-003.says: Direction 0, from above, the rest as FX-PARA-002: turned upside down, row 1 wholly violet and row 8 the least.

FX-PARA-004.says: Direction 90, from the right, the rest as FX-PARA-002: the figure reaches from column 0 to the dot at column 14, so the dot is wholly violet and the block less violet toward the left; the quarter-covered column 11, not part of the figure, is shaded as its place says.

FX-PARA-005.says: Spread 50, the rest as FX-PARA-002: the wash stops half way up the figure; rows 1 to 4 and the dot are untouched.

FX-PARA-006.says: Direction 45, from the upper right, the rest as FX-PARA-002: the dot and the block's top right corner the most violet, the bottom left the least.

FX-PARA-007.says: Overlay, spread 100, opacity 100: the skin, light, is lifted toward the violet's screen and its shadow, darker, pushed toward its multiply; the most at row 8.

FX-PARA-008.says: Soft light, spread 100, opacity 100: gentler than overlay; each channel whose violet is below one half is darkened, blue is lifted.

FX-PARA-009.says: Multiply, spread 100, opacity 100: darkened toward violet, the most at row 8.

FX-PARA-010.says: Screen, spread 100, opacity 100: lightened, none darkened.

FX-PARA-011.says: Add, spread 100, opacity 100: the violet added and held at 1, so the skin's red, already near 1, stops at 1.

FX-PARA-014.says: FX-PARA-001 with the colour written in capitals, #6450A0: the same.

FX-PARA-015.says: Direction keyed from 0 at frame 0 to 180 at frame 4, linear, the rest as FX-PARA-002: frame 0 is FX-PARA-003, frame 2 is FX-PARA-004 and frame 4 is FX-PARA-002: the wash swings round the figure.

FX-PARA-016.says: Spread eased from 0 at frame 0 to 100 at frame 4 on a curve that overshoots, opacity 100, normal: at frame 2 it would pass 100, is held at 100, and is FX-PARA-002; frame 0 is the drawing.

FX-PARA-017.says: FX-PARA-001 moved three pixels right: the same, moved; the wash is worked on the drawing before it moves.

FX-PARA-018.says: Direction 361, above 360. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-PARA-019.says: Spread 101, above 100. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-PARA-020.says: Opacity -1, below 0. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-PARA-021.says: Spread keyed to 150 at frame 4. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-PARA-022.says: Blend "color_burn", which is not a blend. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-PARA-023.says: Colour "#12345", one digit short. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.
